envelope.description: Replace the decline branch with the diff-only degraded path

body.title: Replace the decline branch with the diff-only degraded path
body.summary: In src/mcp/code-review-step/handler.ts replace the s9 decline exit (errorResult('review-declined', ...) at ~handler.ts:211) with: call deps.assembleDiffGrounding(repo); on a both-paths git failure return a CodeReviewStepError (code 'diff-unavailable', retryable:true) and write NO record; otherwise saveState({subject, grounding, groundingMode:'degraded'}) and return next:'emit_judgements' over the diff grounding. In the judgements turn, when the loaded state is marked groundingMode:'degraded', drive runCodeReview with groundingMode:'degraded' + capVerdictAtWarn:true; otherwise (graph path) pass neither. The fresh path + proceed:true poll + graph judgements turn stay byte-identical to s9 (ac6).
acceptanceChecks: the decline branch (proceed:false + state) calls assembleDiffGrounding and returns next:'emit_judgements' (no 'review-declined' error)
a both-paths diff failure returns next:'error' code 'diff-unavailable' and writes NO record
the degraded judgements turn drives runReview with groundingMode:'degraded' + capVerdictAtWarn:true and persists a record
the fresh path + proceed:true poll + graph judgements turn are unchanged (graph path passes neither opt)

tests.name: handler: decline (proceed:false + state) -> assembleDiffGrounding is called, next:'emit_judgements' over the diff grounding, and NO 'review-declined' error
handler: the degraded judgements turn drives runReview with groundingMode:'degraded' + capVerdictAtWarn:true (assert the runReview spy's opts) and persists a record
handler: a diff-unavailable failure (assembleDiffGrounding rejects) -> next:'error' (diff-unavailable), no write
handler ac6 regression: a fresh index (no decline) still returns emit_judgements over graph grounding and drives runReview with the default opts (groundingMode:'full', no cap)
